fee_notes: Royalty is 8% of gross sales, paid weekly. Marketing Fund Fee is 2% of gross sales, paid weekly. Advertising Cooperative is an additional 1%-2% of gross sales if established. Local advertising requirement is currently 0% but may be increased up to 2% of gross sales. Technology Fee is currently $650/month, updated periodically in manuals. Transaction Processing Fee is 2.4%-3% per transaction (majority paid to merchant processor Stripe, currently averaging ~2.36%). All fees marked with * are fixed for the term (increases capped at 50%); unmarked fees may be changed in manuals at franchisor's discretion.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty*1,3 | 8% of gross sales | Payable weekly to be received by Tuesday of the following week (a sales week runs Monday – Saturday) | Gross sales include all revenue from the franchise business, but does not include sales tax.
Marketing Fund Fee*1,2 | 2% of gross sales payable to us | Payable weekly to be received by Tuesday of the following week (a sales week runs Monday – Saturday) | See Note 2 below.
Advertising Cooperative*1,2 | 1% to 2% of gross sales payable to the co-op, if established by us | Payable in accordance with the advertising cooperative's governing documents
Technology Fee1 | Currently $650 | Payable monthly to be received by the first Tuesday of the month | This fee will be updated periodically in our manuals
Transaction Processing Fee1,9 | Currently 2.4% to 3% of each transaction | Payable on each transaction | This fee will be updated periodically in our manuals.
